versions.changelog: Separate configurable report directory defaults from the public skill and improve role-specific security audit guidance.
Add persistent-state and CIK-aware audit coverage, update public docs, and tighten export ignore rules.
Add ClawHub profile to the About Alon block and reorder author links for consistency.
Normalize the public SKILL.md to English, keep bilingual triggers, and align README/author metadata.
Add a short About Alon contact block to the public SKILL.md for ClawHub display surfaces.
Refresh public metadata, update GitHub owner links, and add About Alon contact block.
Declare required binaries and clarify configurable report output.
Normalize display name and install wording.
Clarify default audit scope, local report destination, and pre-check permission boundaries.

- Initial release of the skill providing full-stack static security audits for GitHub repositories or local directories.
- Detects malicious code, backdoors, and supply chain attacks, and generates detailed security reports saved to Obsidian.
- Supports audits triggered by common phrases (e.g., "安全审计", "audit", "check repo") for both remote and local targets.
- Follows a strict offline, read-only static analysis process by default, without installing or executing target code.
- Optional online vulnerability intelligence checks offered only with user consent.
- Clear reports include risk entity listings, logical risks, supplementary checks, installation advice, and final verdict (Safe/Risky/Dangerous).
